line.en:
This project explores the integration of trauma-informed design principles into a modern workplace to create 
an environment that enhances mental well-being, productivity, and a sense of belonging. Located at the HAI 
Offices in Dubai Design District (D3)

brief.en:
The proposal reimagines the existing adaptive reuse office by incorporating 
biophilic design, flexible workspaces, natural lighting, and restorative social areas that foster safety, comfort, collaboration, and emotional resilience. The design demonstrates how human-centered interior architecture can 
transform conventional office spaces into healthier, more inclusive, and inspiring environments that positively 
support both individual well-being and organizational culture.
